==Notes==
*In Jokanur Diggings:
**Although they appear as hostiles, Sunspear Ghosts will not [[attack]].
**If you place a [[Stone Tablet]] on the [[Stone Pedestal]] and have yet to set the other one, the Sunspear Ghosts will run to retrieve their Tablet and return it to its original position.
**Sunspear Ghosts are immune to the traps in the area.
